description: How many resources do you need? Returns the MINIMUM that meets your target (max wait, max turned away, or max utilization) and how the system behaves at that number. This is the question asked before building a place, not after.

avgServiceMinutes.description: Mean time one resource stays occupied, in minutes, e.g. 75.

maxTurnedAway.description: Maximum fraction that leaves without a place (0-1).

maxUtilization.description: Maximum utilization per resource (0-1). The 0.85 rule for hospital beds is this number.

waitingRoom.description: Waiting places in addition to the resources.

name: queue_size
